fields.title: Blogpost
fields.description: This is a simple blogpost web-app that I have developed in Django. The user can create new post, view the post and send comment underneath the post. User can search for the post that they like. This truly a user-friendly Django Blogpost Web-app.

fields.title: Social Media
fields.description: This is a basic Django Social Media Web - app. The user can authenticate into this app. They can post new photos , like the post and follow or unfollow other users. This is absolutely a fantastic Web - app for connecting with your  friend, family and loved ones. My Django Social Media Web - app contains all the features to socialize in digital medium.

fields.title: E - commerce
fields.description: This is my Django E - commerce Web - app. The user can authenticate in this app. They can view all the items. If the user is a vendor, the user can post item for sale in this site. The user can add items to cart and checkout by Stripe Payment Method. The user can search for items for purchase. The vendor can see the orders and what they have launched to sale.

fields.title: Todo List Web - app
fields.description: This is my Django Todo List Web - app. The user can authenticate in this web - app. They can create new Todo task. The user can see their task whether it is in progress or completed. They can update the task if they like and view the detail of the task. The user can also delete their task.

fields.title: Project Management System
fields.description: I have developed my Project Management System mainly with Django and Python.  The User can authenticate in this Web - app. They can create new project and view the details of the project. The user can create new Todo task for each project.  The user can update the project and delete the project. They can upload files and add new notes.

fields.title: Realtime Chat Web - app
fields.description: This is Django Realtime Chat Web - app. I have utilised Django channels and Websoket to developed this Web - app. The user can authenticate itself in this web - app. They can create new rooms for chat and join the chat. This is really a simple Realtime Chat Web - app.

fields.title: Restaurant Booking System
fields.description: This is Django's Restaurant Booking System. The user can submit their details and book their preferred slot. The user can see their booking on the web - app. There are also a list of food items. The user can view the details.

fields.title: Employee Management System
fields.description: My Employee Management System is mainly developed with Python and Django. The user can authenticate in this web - app and they can add new employee, see their details and profiles. They can update the details of their employees and delete. Payroll is added for each and every employee.

fields.title: Content Management System
fields.description: I have developed this Content Management System Web - app. The user can authenticate in this web - app. They can post their content and view their details. Post will be visible on web - app based on their category. All the user will have their own profile.

fields.title: Weather Web - app
fields.description: This is My Django Weather Web - app. I have utilised the OpenWeather API.  This weather web - app gives the information about a certain place. We need to search the name of the place. Afterwards, the temperature, speed of the wind and a brief information about weather will be displayed. This is really an amazing weather related web - app.

fields.title: Movie Streaming Web - app
fields.description: This is one of my fantastic work. I have developed this movie streaming web - app ( Netflix clone ) with mainly Python, and Django. This web - app has all the basic features of Netflix. The user can authenticate. Based on the profile preference, the category of movies will be displayed on the web - app. The user can create more than one profile for themselves.

fields.title: Map Locator
fields.description: This is my Django Map Locator. It is focused on folium which is a great python package. The user can search for any place, the web - app can display the place. This entire project is developed with Python and Django.

fields.title: Online Market Place
fields.description: This is Django Online Market place. This project is developed with Python and Django. This Online Market Place bears all the basic features including authentication, upload of selling article and detail view of that article. The buyer can contact the seller. There is a dashboard for the seller to see the articles he had uploaded. This is Web - app is a great site where all the people can come together to buy and sell.

fields.title: Finance Tracker
fields.description: This is a basic finance tracker developed with Python and Django. The user can authenticate and see his entries of expense and balance. The user can create new entries of the expense and gain. Detail view is visible on home page as soon as the user is logged in. Each and every user can have their own record of transaction. This Web - app helps the user to manage their finance.

fields.title: Django Text To HTML
fields.description: This is an  amazing web - app of Django Text To HTML. This web - app helps the user to share the code with proper highlight. The user can authenticate into this web - app. The user can copy the code block by using the copy button. It supports all the required markdown.

fields.title: Django Polling Web - app
fields.description: This is Django's polling web - app. The user can authenticate in this web - app. The user can poll for the available web - app. Each and every user will have one chance to poll. If the user have completed the poll, that particular user can't poll once again for that poll. The user can see the percentage of poll for each poll. I have followed Django's activity project to develop this project.

fields.title: Crowd Funding Web - app
fields.description: This is Django's Crowd Funding Web - app. In order to make donation, the user have to authenticate in this web - app. The user will go to the donation page and then they will submit the information for making donation. After that, the user will pass through Stripe Payment Method. After the successful donation, the user will be redirected to success page.

fields.title: Library Management System
fields.description: This is my Django Library Management System. I have developed this web - app mainly with Python, Django. The user can authenticate in this web - app. The can issue a book. They can see the details of the book. They can update the details  of that record. If the user fails to return the book within time, the user will be fined for each day. This Web - app can help to manage the books in organised manner.
